description: Empirical land-climate targets from WorldClim 2.1 monthly 1970-2000 normals at 10 arc-minute resolution, sampled on the native 4096-cell Fibonacci mesh. Downloaded data remain ignored and are not redistributed.

sources.tolerance_basis: Three-degree Earth-like land-climate model-fit tolerance; not a statistical confidence interval.
sources.source_license: Academic and other non-commercial use; redistribution and commercial use require prior permission.
sources.source_citation: Fick, S.E. and R.J. Hijmans, 2017. WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas.
sources.source_processing: Twelve GeoTIFF months sampled at 4096 native Fibonacci centers; complete land samples only; monthly values averaged per cell then across land

sources.tolerance_basis: Four-degree Earth-like seasonal-range model-fit tolerance; not a statistical confidence interval.
sources.source_license: Academic and other non-commercial use; redistribution and commercial use require prior permission.
sources.source_citation: Fick, S.E. and R.J. Hijmans, 2017. WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas.
sources.source_processing: Twelve GeoTIFF months sampled at 4096 native Fibonacci centers; complete land samples only; per-cell monthly maximum minus minimum averaged across land

sources.tolerance_basis: Twenty-five-percent Earth-like land-precipitation model-fit tolerance; not a statistical confidence interval.

sources.source_citation: Fick, S.E. and R.J. Hijmans, 2017. WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas.
